rage.note: Not in heavy armor; no spells or concentration while raging; ends early if the barbarian neither attacked a hostile creature nor took damage since their last turn.

frenzy.note: Raging in a frenzy: one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each turn; one level of exhaustion when the rage ends.

brutal-critical-1-die.note: On a melee critical hit, one more weapon damage die (two at 13th level, three at 17th).

intimidating-presence.note: Action: one creature within 30 feet makes a WIS save (DC 8 + pb + CHA) or is frightened until the end of the barbarian's next turn.

relentless-rage.note: Dropping to 0 HP while raging: a DC 10 CON save to drop to 1 HP instead; the DC goes up by 5 each use and resets on a short or long rest.

bardic-inspiration-d6.note: Bonus action: one creature within 60 feet gets the "inspired" condition with source "Bardic Inspiration d6" (d8 from 5th level, d10 from 10th, d12 from 15th) for 10 minutes.

song-of-rest-d6.note: A short rest with the bard: everyone who spends Hit Dice regains an extra 1d6 HP (1d8 from 9th level, 1d10 from 13th, 1d12 from 17th).

cutting-words.note: Reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration to subtract the die from a creature's attack roll, ability check or damage roll.

superior-inspiration.note: Rolling initiative with no Bardic Inspiration left gives back one use.

channel-divinity-1-rest.note: Turn Undead: undead within 30 feet make a WIS save or are turned for 1 minute.

channel-divinity-preserve-life.note: Channel Divinity: share out 5 × cleric level HP among creatures within 30 feet, none above half its HP maximum.

disciple-of-life.note: Healing spells of 1st level or higher heal 2 + the spell's level more.

divine-intervention.note: Action: roll d100; at or below the cleric level the deity intervenes. After an intervention, not again for 7 days; otherwise again after a long rest.

wild-shape-cr-1-4-or-below-no-flying-or-.note: Beast forms up to CR 1/4 without flying or swimming (CR 1/2 without flying from 4th level, CR 1 from 8th) for half the druid level in hours; the beast's HP take damage first.

natural-recovery.note: During a short rest: recover spell slots with a combined level up to half the druid level (rounded up), none 6th level or higher.

action-surge-1-use.note: One more action this turn (only once on the same turn).

survivor.note: At the start of each turn with half HP or less (but above 0), regain 5 + CON modifier HP.

ki.note: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind: 1 ki each; ki save DC 8 + pb + WIS.

martial-arts.note: Unarmed strikes and monk weapons use DEX or STR and the Martial Arts die (d4, d6 from 5th level, d8 from 11th, d10 from 17th); one unarmed strike as a bonus action after attacking.

stunning-strike.note: On a melee weapon hit, spend 1 ki: the target makes a CON save or is stunned until the end of the monk's next turn.

tranquility.note: After a long rest the monk has Sanctuary (DC 8 + WIS + pb) until the next long rest.

quivering-palm.note: 3 ki on an unarmed hit; later an action: the target makes a CON save, dropping to 0 HP on a failure or taking 10d10 necrotic on a success.

lay-on-hands.note: A pool of HP: spend any amount to heal that many; 5 points cure one disease or poison.

divine-smite.note: 1d8 more against an undead or a fiend.

channel-divinity-sacred-weapon.note: Channel Divinity: + CHA modifier to attack rolls with one weapon for 1 minute; it sheds bright light.

cleansing-touch.note: Action: end one spell on yourself or a willing creature you touch.

holy-nimbus.note: Action, 1 minute: enemies starting their turn within 30 feet take 10 radiant; advantage on saves against fiends' and undead's spells.

hunters-prey-colossus-slayer.note: Only against a creature below its HP maximum.

sneak-attack.note: Needs advantage on the attack, or another enemy of the target within 5 feet of it (and no disadvantage).

stroke-of-luck.note: Turn a miss into a hit, or a failed ability check's d20 into a 20.

font-of-magic.note: Bonus action: spend 2/3/5/6/7 points for a level 1-5 spell slot (gone after a long rest), or turn a slot into its level in points.

flexible-casting-creating-spell-slots.note: Slots made from Sorcery Points vanish after a long rest.

elemental-affinity.note: A spell of the dragon ancestor's damage type adds the CHA modifier to one damage roll; 1 Sorcery Point gives resistance to that type for 1 hour.

dark-ones-blessing.note: Bringing a hostile creature to 0 HP gives temp HP equal to CHA modifier + warlock level.

dark-ones-own-luck.note: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll.

fiendish-resilience.note: Resistance to one damage type, chosen after each short or long rest (not against magical or silver weapons).

hurl-through-hell.note: On an attack hit: the target vanishes until the end of the warlock's next turn and takes 10d10 psychic unless it is a fiend.

eldritch-master.note: 1 minute: regain all Pact Magic slots.

arcane-recovery.note: After a short rest: recover spell slots with a combined level up to half the wizard level (rounded up), none 6th level or higher.

overchannel.note: Maximum damage with a 1st-5th level wizard spell. Again before a long rest: 2d12 necrotic per spell level to the wizard (1d12 more each further time), ignoring resistance.

spell-mastery.note: One 1st-level and one 2nd-level spell can be cast at their lowest level without a slot.

signature-spell.note: Two 3rd-level spells, each cast once at 3rd level without a slot between rests.
